decisions.reason: High investment in a multi-model product line and a dedicated page create strong sunk costs and public commitment, so early results are seen as temporary and the firm keeps it.
Only a website mention signals less public commitment, but sunk costs and the short time since launch allow management to attribute any disappointment to temporary causes, so keep.
Although only mentioned, the product line represents sunk investment and the firm's expansion makes early results appear temporary, so keep with moderate drop risk.
A dedicated page and multi-model line signal high visible commitment, so escalation of commitment leads to keep despite any early weak results.
A dedicated page shows public commitment and the close-to-core component's early results remain attributable to temporary causes, so keep.
With only a mention and no product line, commitment is lowest, but escalation of commitment still favors keep because costs are sunk and results are early, though drop risk is highest.
